moveReviews.rationale: Loke distinguishes mere scientific non-exclusion from the independent deductive argument still requiring defended true premises.
Linford supplies several positive limits on global inference and does not infer falsity merely from missing proof.
Loke’s future-prediction analogy does not answer locally indistinguishable global structures, although he limits its role.
Linford presents nonmetric time as a live conceptual alternative for skeptical withholding, not as established actuality.
Loke assumes ordered points must possess finite or infinite metric extension, the exact issue nonmetricity denies.
Linford explains the observational-equivalence construction positively and carefully restricts its conclusion to local evidence.
Linford consistently distinguishes no length from finite or infinite length and applies Loke’s stated beginning criterion.
Loke redirects from whether the physical ground is timeless to the undisputed presence of emergent temporal events.
Linford offers a parity argument with a principled common feature rather than exempting only his preferred ontology.
Loke shifts grounding and technical creation language into temporal happening language despite the layered distinction.
Linford gives a concrete grounding mechanism rather than relying on the named theory or its proponents’ status.
Linford consistently separates derived temporal relations from their proposed ground without any serious catalog-defined defect.
Loke moves from reciprocal scientific interaction to directed efficient causation, changing the relevant causal sense.
Linford expressly claims skeptical nonacceptance and leaves alternatives open, so he does not argue from failed disproof.
Loke concludes design partly because alternatives allegedly fail and design has not been excluded, without positive comparison.
Linford conditionally moves from causation within physics to the whole, but acknowledges the interpretation remains contestable.
Loke establishes a cause of arrangement but presents it as answering the broader cause-of-total-physical-reality question.
Linford’s countermodel is used only to show non-entailment, so it need not be established as actual.
Linford directly addresses why reciprocal interaction terminology does not establish asymmetric causation; no serious tag survives.
Loke assumes every antecedent differentiator must be a cause, embedding the disputed causal principle in its defense.
Linford initially offers analogous support and explicitly treats parity as a challenge, not as proof of necessity.
Loke gives a principled logical difference involving an efficient selector, though it leaves evidential parity unresolved.
Loke dismisses antecedent nomic constraints by presuming only causes can perform differentiating explanatory work.
Linford supplies field-property reasoning rather than treating cited thinkers or scientific authority as decisive.
Loke broadens every differentiating explanation into causation, thereby presupposing the principle he needs to establish.
Linford maintains a stable distinction between explanatory reasons and efficient causes and applies it directly.
Linford constructs a structurally parallel hypothetical while acknowledging its conditional and controversial character.
Linford clarifies the limited epistemic parity claim and draws its conditional consequence without asserting causeless beginnings.
Loke’s borrower analogy assumes all regress members lack a resource obtainable only from an external first source.
Linford offers a coherent counterpossibility sufficient for his skeptical burden rather than asserting it is actual.
Loke invokes instability and finite persistence while presupposing the durational structure that nonmetric time denies.
Loke builds alternative control and personhood into the claimed capacities instead of independently deriving those features.
Linford asks for a nondurational account and concedes such an account remains open, avoiding an ignorance inference.
Loke’s omniscient chooser coherently rebuts deliberation as necessary but does not claim this establishes the actual cause.
Loke redescribes eventlessness as free withholding, presupposing the personal control the description is meant to prove.

overallBlunderReviews.rationale: The frozen blunder concerns underdevelopment and outside references, not reliance on anyone’s status as settling the regress.
The agency route treats instability, withholding, and freedom as mutually validating without independent support for control.
The initial parity analogy was compressed but later received field-based support; weakness alone is not special pleading.
The move from internal emergent causation to the whole overlooks the decisive change in explanatory scope.
